we have developed a new framework for analyzing graph Laplacians, which allows us to understand the convergence of graph Laplacian spectra for a wide variety of graphs, and we have applied this framework to analyze the LLE algorithm and to understand the relationship between different graph Laplacian constructions.

the convergence of a graph Laplacian is determined solely by the convergence of its spectrum, and the convergence of the spectrum is determined by the convergence of the limit operator.
